steps.title: Load destination plates onto deck
steps.instruction: Place up to six destination plates on the deck in order of lowest to highest slot number; for two plates use slots 4 and 5. The protocol pools all columns into the first four wells (A1‑D1) of column 1 for each plate.

substeps.instruction: Place plates on deck in order of lowest to highest slot number (e.g., for two plates, slots 4 and 5).
Pool all columns into the first four wells (A1‑D1) of column 1 for each plate.

steps.title: Pick up pipette tips
steps.instruction: Pick up fresh pipette tips from the tip rack.

steps.title: Aspirate from column 12 to 7
steps.instruction: Aspirate 20 µL from column 12 of plate 1 and dispense it into column 7 of the same plate.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate 20 µL from column 12 of plate 1.
Dispense the aspirated volume into column 7 of plate 1.

steps.title: Aspirate from column 6 to 2
steps.instruction: Aspirate 20 µL from column 6 of plate 1 and dispense it into column 2 of the same plate.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate 20 µL from column 6 of plate 1.
Dispense the aspirated volume into column 2 of plate 1.

steps.title: Dispense pooled volume into column 1
steps.instruction: Dispense all aspirated volumes into the first four wells (A1‑D1) of column 1 of each destination plate.

substeps.instruction: Dispense all previously aspirated volumes into wells A1‑D1 of column 1 for each plate.

steps.title: Shift wells E1-H1 to A1-D1
steps.instruction: Move the contents of wells E1‑H1 to wells A1‑D1 within column 1 of each plate.

substeps.instruction: Transfer material from wells E1‑H1 to wells A1‑D1 in column 1 of each plate.
